title: Ship a domain data product
objectives: Build a product table with the types and key its contract promises
Keep every customer, including those with no orders
Prove every row points at a real customer

exercises.prompt: Build customer_summary: customer_id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, segment VARCHAR, orders INTEGER, revenue DECIMAL(12, 2) and last_order DATE, one row per customer in customers (0 orders and 0 revenue when they have none; last_order empty). Orders for unknown customers aren't part of the product. End with SELECT * FROM customer_summary ORDER BY customer_id.
hints: The starter groups orders, so Tailspin (no orders) is missing and unknown customer 9 sneaks in.
Start from customers and LEFT JOIN orders, so every customer stays and unknown ones don't appear.

CREATE TABLE with the contract's types first, then INSERT ... SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.segment, count(o.order_id), coalesce(sum(o.amount), 0), max(o.order_date) ... GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.segment.
